spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact SVG2 side content attribute on textPath with the spec's left|right vocabulary, and the support probe measures the spec's defined behaviour (right reverses the path) via getStartPositionOfChar rather than attribute reflection.

interactive.rationale: Text input, side radio group, startOffset and font-size sliders all drive the live SVG, the measurement table, and the regenerated markup snippet.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a side toggle plus a geometric inside/outside measurement, which is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles zero-visible-glyph states (high startOffset), empty label text, and the unsupported-browser branch with an explicit measured 'unchanged geometry' message; deeper end-of-path behaviour is the dedicated off-the-ends concept.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5422782593761280 and the spec's TextPathElementSideAttribute anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the real geometric contract (open-path reversal, circle inside/outside, default-left) plus honestly-worded attribute round-trip and passing baseline textPath assertions; no IDL is asserted because the published ED does not define side IDL yet.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified headless (Chromium 141) at desktop and mobile widths with screenshots read, controls driven over CDP, console clean, and the measured probe correctly reporting unsupported with deltaX 0.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts textpath-side-right-flips-geometry on the supported branch and textpath-side-unsupported-fallback-labelled on the fallback branch, with intentional single-line console logging.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables (SVG fills/strokes via classes), text pairs are AA (charcoal/black on ivory/paper/stone), and no button background is overridden without its colour.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, fieldset/legend radio group, visible focus-visible outlines, svg role=img with desc, and a single debounced aria-live polite readout announcing side value and measured placement.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: SVG scales via viewBox + 100% inline-size, controls flex-wrap, no horizontal overflow measured at 360px, tap targets at 44px min-height; verified at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported branch on a Chrome 156 build
openQuestions.detail: This page was built and verified against Chromium 141, where side is honestly reported unsupported (measured deltaX 0 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGTextPathSideAttribute — the implementation postdates 141). When a Chrome 156 dev/stable build is available to the verification environment, drive the side toggle there and confirm the supported branch: banner flips to yes, radial distance measures inside the 90px radius, and the textpath-side-right-flips-geometry assert fires.

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive SVG demo controls touch targets accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native labelled controls, visible focus, 4.5:1 text contrast, state changes not conveyed by colour alone, and a single debounced polite live region per page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native inputs with visible labels and :focus-visible outlines; support verdicts pair colour with icon + wording; one aria-live=polite output is debounced at 300ms so slider scrubbing does not spam screen readers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap for control rows, intrinsic/logical sizing (inline-size, min()) instead of fixed widths, display:block on replaced elements like svg, and never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap with min(100%, Nrem) inline sizes, the stage SVG is display:block with viewBox + 100% inline-size and auto block-size, and the only overflow container is an explicit overflow-x:auto table scroller.

summary: Canonical-angle playground for the side attribute: one clockwise circular path, a left/right toggle, startOffset and font-size controls, and a geometric probe that reports support only when the side="right" copy's measured first-glyph start actually lands at the far end of the probe path. On the Chromium 141 build environment it honestly reports not-supported with unchanged measured geometry.
